jobs.description: LocationDuisburgApplication areaFaculty of Physics, Theoretical PhysicsDoctoral Researcher at the interface of theoretical physics and computational materials science (f/m/d)TV-L 13 (gross 44.493 € - 63.239 €)We are looking for a curious and motivated PhD candidate to join our newly established research group at the interface of theoretical physics and computational materials science. The project explores how interactions between electrons and atomic magnetic moments give rise to the collective behaviour of magnetic materials. A central research direction is to understand and design materials that support topological spin textures such as skyrmions and hopfions and investigate their potential for brain-inspired, or neuromorphic, computing.Start of employment2027-03-01Duration of employment3.5 yearsWorking time29 h 52 min (75%)Your main tasksYou will carry out high-throughput simulations: automated sets of calculations across selected materials and magnetic configurations. Using density functional theory (DFT), with established software such as VASP and FLEUR, you will investigate electronic structure and determine the magnetic interactions that govern how atomic moments arrange themselves and evolve. Particular attention will be paid to materials in which relativistic effects and competing magnetic interactions favour complex spin textures. Relevant material families include two-dimensional magnets, rare-earth intermetallics and magnetic Weyl semimetals.A key question is how quantum calculations can be translated into reliable spin models that predict the stability and dynamics of topological spin textures. You will combine physical modelling with physics-constrained machine learning, including symbolic regression, to develop spin Hamiltonians describing interactions between atomic magnetic moments. These will underpin atomistic simulations within an automated workflow for identifying promising materials and investigating how composition, doping or strain can tune their magnetic behaviour.The duties include teaching obligations amounting to 3 hours per week.You will be given the opportunity to pursue further academic qualification as part of this role.Your profile- a Master’s degree in Imagine working at the intersection of engineering, IT, and software development, ensuring the reliable operation and continuous improvement of existing applications while driving the digitalization of FPT workflows. Collaborate with both internal and external development partners to translate engineering needs into sustainable digital solutions, supporting their development throughout the entire application lifecycle. By taking dedicated ownership of these applications, you will help ensure business continuity, allowing our FPT engineers to focus on customer projects and their core engineering responsibilities.How You’ll Make an Impact * Own and manage business-critical Field Performance Testing (FPT) applications globally* Ensure reliable operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management across international locations* Drive digitalization and automation initiatives to improve efficiency, standardization, and user experience* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective software solutions* Develop and enhance FPT applications while coordinating with internal teams and external partners* Support testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement to ensure application stability and business continuityWhat You Bring* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field* Experience in software development, application management, digitalization, or IT project environments* Strong hands-on skills in programming, databases, scripting, and business application technologies (e.g., Azure, Power Platform, Python, SQL, GitHub)* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, particularly using GitLab and GitLab Runner* Knowledge of Machine Learning and its application in digital automation and workflow optimization* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently in an international environment; fluent English required, German is a plusAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs #RPO

jobs.description: The Barkhausen Institut performs research on the latest hardware, software and communication technologies and demonstrates their application in tomorrow’s society. Then you should know: We don’t hire resumes, we hire people. We are looking for potential and want to actively foster it. That’s why we encourage you to apply!What we provide- An open and creative team- Agile working hours and workflows- Cross-disciplinary projects- Work on future technologies- Flat hierarchies for your ideas and flexible teams- Our remuneration is based on the collective agreement for the federal states. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As Head of Development for Integrally Geared Compressors (IGCs) you are responsible for developing and improving the design of IGCs based on market requirements. You and your motivated team are part of the energy transition and you are in strong cooperation with other international development teams like Core technology or Product Excellence. The IGC portfolio and development pipeline includes core markets (Air Separation, PTA) as well as driving innovation to position Siemens Energy’s IGC Product Line in emerging markets (CCUS, LDES, decarbonized heat etc.), plus growing in Service and M&U business.How You’ll Make an Impact * Provide technical leadership to the team by coaching engineers, supporting technical decision-making, fostering collaboration, and contributing to complex technical challenges where required* Develop, implement and maintain IGC Core Compressor Design Standards and Rules* Plan, budget and assign team resources according to development projects and requested order support with prioritization. Build a strong, global cooperation with our internal teams, external partners, and customers* Innovate, creatively apply lessons learned (prevention of technical issues) and implement cost-effective solutions (cost-out) based on feedback during the whole lifecycle of our product line* Act as technical authority and provide technical leadership for critical customer applications, complex order execution challenges, and major product issuesWhat You Bring* Completed studies (Bachelor/Master) in Engineering or equivalent* Team management experience, either by leading a direct-reporting functional department or leading project-based engineering teams* Experience with rotating equipment with in-depth knowledge of integrally geared compressor design and market trends* Strong background and experience in IGC Core Compressor design (10+ years)* Virtual collaboration in global teams and the use of lean methods, experience in task management with JIRA preferred* Business-fluent German and English language skillsAbout the TeamOur Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining-the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. A shorter contract term is possible by arrangement.In the COANDRI cooperation project, an innovative framework is to be developed that enables flexible and vendor-independent integration of a wide variety of robotic systems. At its core are five essential building blocks: First, a unified capability abstraction will be created to ensure universal connectivity of diverse systems. Second, the framework relies on declarative, versioned, and combinable skills organized in an API-like architecture. Third, COANDRI enables self-service authoring based on LLM and VLM reasoning, patented tactile-sensing hardware, and AI-assisted skill capture using smart glasses and a voice agent.
